retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
BRUTE FORCE ATTACK

DESCRIPTION:
A brute-force attack involves systematically attempting numerous passwords until valid credentials are discovered.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1110 | Brute Force

INDICATORS:
- Large numbers of failed logins
- Repeated authentication attempts
- Account lockouts
- Login attempts from unusual regions

DETECTION RULES:
- Excessive failed logins
- Authentication spikes

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- User accounts
- VPN gateways
- Remote access systems
title: BRUTE FORCE ATTACK
